title: Intermittent theta burst stimulation to extend early ketamine response in treatment-resistant depression: A preliminary enriched randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial.
title_cn: 间歇性θ爆发刺激延长氯胺酮对难治性抑郁症早期疗效：一项初步富集式随机、双盲、假刺激对照试验
summary_cn: 在对两次低剂量氯胺酮已有早期应答的难治性抑郁症患者中，5天加速间歇性θ爆发刺激在49天随访中与更低的总体抑郁症状相关。
detail_cn: 研究先以两次0.5 mg/kg氯胺酮诱导早期应答，再将38名应答者随机分配至5天加速间歇性θ爆发刺激或假刺激。混合效应模型显示活性刺激组在随机阶段的总体MADRS评分更低，但组别×时间交互和反应维持的生存分析均未达到统计学显著。15例静息态功能磁共振成像为探索性分析。该富集设计主要适用于氯胺酮早期应答者，样本量有限，尚不足以支持常规联合治疗。
weekly_takeaway_cn: 本期纳入1项难治性抑郁症随机、双盲、假刺激对照研究。在两次低剂量氯胺酮后出现早期应答的患者中，5天加速间歇性θ爆发刺激在49天随访期间与更低的总体抑郁症状相关；但组别×时间交互及维持反应的生存分析均未显著。结果提示神经调控可能有助延长快速抗抑郁效应，但受小样本、富集人群及探索性影像分析限制，仍需更大样本验证。
type: 随机、双盲、假刺激对照试验
abstract: Adults with treatment-resistant depression who responded to two low-dose ketamine infusions were randomized to 5 days of accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation or sham stimulation. Thirty-eight participants were randomized. The mixed-effects model showed a significant overall group effect favoring active stimulation during follow-up, while the group-by-time interaction and response-maintenance survival analysis were not significant. Exploratory imaging analyses involved 15 participants.
evidence: 正式同行评审；小样本、富集随机设计

title: Serum brain-derived neurotrophic factor following oral esketamine in treatment-resistant depression: Results from a randomized placebo-controlled trial
type: 随机、安慰剂对照试验（补录排除：非本期首次在线）
abstract: In a randomized placebo-controlled trial in treatment-resistant depression, low-dose prolonged oral esketamine did not alter serum BDNF levels compared with placebo. BDNF increased similarly in both groups, which the authors note may reflect co-medications or other confounding factors.
evidence: 正式同行评审；不作为本周新发表论文

title: ACC-related functional circuit organisation across static, dynamic and directed connectivity in internet gaming disorder.
type: 横断面静息态 fMRI 研究（补录排除：非本期首次在线）
abstract: Compared with healthy controls, individuals with internet gaming disorder showed alterations in static, dynamic, state-based and directed connectivity involving anterior cingulate subregions, posterior medial cortex and frontal control regions.
evidence: 正式同行评审；不作为本周新发表论文

title: Identification of TAS2R-targeting bioactive compounds against metabolic decline: A novel ex vivo methodology based on enteroendocrine and inflammatory readouts.
type: 大鼠离体机制研究（补录排除：非本期首次在线）
abstract: An ex vivo rat jejunum platform profiled subtype-selective bitter receptor agonists. Enterohormone secretion and cytokine responses in inflamed tissue varied by receptor and dose. The study identified rat Tas2r108, Tas2r119, Tas2r140 and Tas2r143 as functional targets for specific compounds.
evidence: 正式同行评审；间接机制证据，未证明与抑郁症直接相关

title: Peripheral immune markers and choroid plexus volumes as predictors of change in depressive symptoms: Insights from the EMBARC study.
type: 多中心临床试验队列二次分析（补录排除：非本期首次在线）
abstract: Among 222 adults with major depressive disorder in EMBARC, a peripheral cytokine/chemokine profile including IL-6, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta predicted less symptom improvement over 8 weeks. Interactions between immune markers and choroid plexus volumes were not significant.
evidence: 正式同行评审；关联/预测证据，非屏障因果验证
